verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן וַיִּשְׁאַל֩ דָּוִ֨ד בַּֽיהוָ֤ה׀ לֵאמֹר֙ הַאֶעֱלֶ֗ה בְּאַחַת֙ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלָ֖יו עֲלֵ֑ה וַיֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אָ֥נָה אֶעֱלֶ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר חֶבְרֹֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên way·yiš·’al dā·wiḏ Yah·weh lê·mōr ha·’e·‘ĕ·leh bə·’a·ḥaṯ ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lāw ‘ă·lêh way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’ā·nāh ’e·‘ĕ·leh way·yō·mer ḥeḇ·rō·nāh
verses.literal: Some time later . . . David inquired of the LORD Should I go up to one of the towns of Judah Go up the LORD answered . . . Then David asked Where should I go To Hebron replied the LORD
verses.literalPt: E SUCEDEU depois disto que Davi consultou ao SENHOR, dizendo: Subirei a alguma das cidades de Judá? E disse-lhe o SENHOR: Sobe. E falou Davi: Para onde subirei? E disse: Para Hebrom.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַל שָׁם֙ דָּוִ֔ד וְגַ֖ם שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשָׁ֑יו אֲחִינֹ֙עַם֙ הַיִּזְרְעֵלִ֔ית וַאֲבִיגַ֕יִל אֵ֖שֶׁת נָבָ֥ל הַֽכַּרְמְלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al šām dā·wiḏ wə·ḡam šə·tê nā·šāw ’ă·ḥî·nō·‘am hay·yiz·rə·‘ê·lîṯ wa·’ă·ḇî·ḡa·yil ’ê·šeṯ nā·ḇāl hak·kar·mə·lî
verses.literal: So David . . . went there with his two wives Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel
verses.literalPt: E subiu Davi para lá, e também as suas duas mulheres, Ainoã, a jizreelita, e Abigail, a mulher de Nabal, o carmelita.

verses.original: וַאֲנָשָׁ֧יו אֲשֶׁר־ עִמּ֛וֹ הֶעֱלָ֥ה דָוִ֖ד אִ֣ישׁ וּבֵית֑וֹ וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ בְּעָרֵ֥י חֶבְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nā·šāw ’ă·šer- ‘im·mōw he·‘ĕ·lāh ḏā·wiḏ ’îš ū·ḇê·ṯōw way·yê·šə·ḇū bə·‘ā·rê ḥeḇ·rō·wn
verses.literal: David also took the men who were with him each with his household and they settled in the towns near Hebron
verses.literalPt: Fez também Davi subir os homens que estavam com ele, cada um com a sua família; e habitaram nas cidades de Hebrom.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּמְשְׁחוּ־ שָׁ֧ם אֶת־ דָּוִ֛ד לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיַּגִּ֤דוּ לְדָוִד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַנְשֵׁי֙ יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר קָבְר֖וּ אֶת־ שָׁאֽוּל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’an·šê yə·hū·ḏāh way·yim·šə·ḥū- šām ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ lə·me·leḵ ‘al- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh way·yag·gi·ḏū lə·ḏā·wiḏ lê·mōr ’an·šê yā·ḇêš gil·‘āḏ ’ă·šer qā·ḇə·rū ’eṯ- šā·’ūl
verses.literal: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah And they told David . . . It was the men of Jabesh-gilead . . . who buried Saul
verses.literalPt: Então vieram os homens de Judá, e ungiram ali a Davi rei sobre a casa de Judá. E deram avisos a Davi, dizendo: Os homens de Jabes-Gileade foram os que sepultaram a Saul.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח דָּוִד֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֖י יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם בְּרֻכִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֜ם הַחֶ֣סֶד הַזֶּ֗ה עִם־ אֲדֹֽנֵיכֶם֙ עִם־ שָׁא֔וּל וַֽתִּקְבְּר֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ dā·wiḏ mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- ’an·šê yā·ḇêš gil·‘āḏ way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem bə·ru·ḵîm ’at·tem Yah·weh ’ă·šer ‘ă·śî·ṯem ha·ḥe·seḏ haz·zeh ‘im- ’ă·ḏō·nê·ḵem ‘im- šā·’ūl wat·tiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: So David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead . . . to tell them The LORD bless you because you showed this kindness to Saul your lord . . . when you buried him
verses.literalPt: Então enviou Davi mensageiros aos homens de Jabes-Gileade, para dizer-lhes: Benditos sejais vós do SENHOR, que fizestes tal beneficência a vosso senhor, a Saul, e o sepultastes!

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה יַֽעַשׂ־ יְהוָ֥ה עִמָּכֶ֖ם חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת וְגַ֣ם אָנֹכִ֗י אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה אִתְּכֶם֙ הַטּוֹבָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ya·‘aś- Yah·weh ‘im·mā·ḵem ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ wə·ḡam ’ā·nō·ḵî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’it·tə·ḵem haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer ‘ă·śî·ṯem had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: Now may the LORD show you loving devotion and faithfulness and I will also show you the same favor because you have done this
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, o SENHOR use convosco de beneficência e fidelidade; e também eu vos farei este bem, porquanto fizestes isto.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀ תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יְדֵיכֶ֗ם וִֽהְיוּ֙ לִבְנֵי־ חַ֔יִל כִּי־ מֵ֖ת אֲדֹנֵיכֶ֣ם שָׁא֑וּל וְגַם־ אֹתִ֗י מָשְׁח֧וּ בֵית־ יְהוּדָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh te·ḥĕ·zaq·nāh yə·ḏê·ḵem wih·yū liḇ·nê- ḥa·yil kî- mêṯ ’ă·ḏō·nê·ḵem šā·’ūl wə·ḡam- ’ō·ṯî mā·šə·ḥū ḇêṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh lə·me·leḵ ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Now then be strong . . . . . . and courageous . . . for though Saul - your lord is dead the house of Judah has anointed me as their king . . .
verses.literalPt: Esforcem-se, pois, agora as vossas mãos, e sede homens valentes, pois Saul, vosso senhor, é morto, mas também os da casa de Judá já me ungiram a mim por seu rei.

verses.original: וְאַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן־ נֵ֔ר שַׂר־ צָבָ֖א אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְשָׁא֑וּל לָקַ֗ח אֶת־ אִ֥ישׁ בֹּ֙שֶׁת֙ בֶּן־ שָׁא֔וּל וַיַּעֲבִרֵ֖הוּ מַחֲנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·nêr ben- nêr śar- ṣā·ḇā ’ă·šer lə·šā·’ūl lā·qaḥ ’eṯ- ’îš bō·šeṯ ben- šā·’ūl way·ya·‘ă·ḇi·rê·hū ma·ḥă·nā·yim
verses.literal: Meanwhile, Abner son of Ner the commander of Saul’s army took Saul’s son Ish-bosheth moved him to Mahanaim
verses.literalPt: Porém Abner, filho de Ner, capitão do exército de Saul, tomou a Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, e o fez passar a Maanaim,

verses.original: וַיַּמְלִכֵ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד וְאֶל־ הָאֲשׁוּרִ֖י וְאֶֽל־ יִזְרְעֶ֑אל וְעַל־ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ וְעַל־ בִּנְיָמִ֔ן וְעַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כֻּלֹּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yam·li·ḵê·hū ’el- hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·’el- hā·’ă·šū·rî wə·’el- yiz·rə·‘el wə·‘al- ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·‘al- bin·yā·min wə·‘al- yiś·rā·’êl kul·lōh
verses.literal: and made him king over Gilead . . . Asher . . . Jezreel Ephraim . . . and Benjamin over all Israel
verses.literalPt: E o constituiu rei sobre Gileade, e sobre os assuritas, e sobre Jizreel, e sobre Efraim, e sobre Benjamim, e sobre todo o Israel.

verses.original: בֶּן־ אַרְבָּעִ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה אִֽישׁ־ בֹּ֣שֶׁת בֶּן־ שָׁא֗וּל בְּמָלְכוֹ֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּשְׁתַּ֥יִם שָׁנִ֖ים מָלָ֑ךְ אַ֚ךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה הָי֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י דָוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh ’îš- bō·šeṯ ben- šā·’ūl bə·mā·lə·ḵōw ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl ū·šə·ta·yim šā·nîm mā·lāḵ ’aḵ bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh hā·yū ’a·ḥă·rê ḏā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Saul’s son Ish-bosheth was forty years old . . . when he began to reign over Israel and he reigned for two years The house of Judah however followed . . . David
verses.literalPt: Da idade de quarenta anos era Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, quando começou a reinar sobre Israel, e reinou dois anos; mas os da casa de Judá seguiam a Davi.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִסְפַּ֣ר הַיָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיָ֨ה דָוִ֥ד מֶ֛לֶךְ בְּחֶבְר֖וֹן עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֥ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî mis·par hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer hā·yāh ḏā·wiḏ me·leḵ bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn ‘al- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm wə·šiš·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: And the length of time that . . . David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months
verses.literalPt: E foi o número dos dias que Davi reinou em Hebrom, sobre a casa de Judá, sete anos e seis meses.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ אַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן־ נֵ֔ר וְעַבְדֵ֖י אִֽישׁ־ בֹּ֣שֶׁת בֶּן־ שָׁא֑וּל מִֽמַּחֲנַ֖יִם גִּבְעֽוֹנָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ’aḇ·nêr ben- nêr wə·‘aḇ·ḏê ’îš- bō·šeṯ ben- šā·’ūl mim·ma·ḥă·na·yim giḇ·‘ō·w·nāh
verses.literal: One day Abner son of Ner and the servants of Ish-bosheth son of Saul marched out from Mahanaim to Gibeon
verses.literalPt: Então saiu Abner, filho de Ner, com os servos de Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, de Maanaim a Gibeom.

verses.original: וְיוֹאָ֨ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֜ה וְעַבְדֵ֤י דָוִד֙ יָֽצְא֔וּ וַֽיִּפְגְּשׁ֛וּם עַל־ בְּרֵכַ֥ת גִּבְע֖וֹן יַחְדָּ֑ו וַיֵּ֨שְׁב֜וּ אֵ֤לֶּה עַל־ הַבְּרֵכָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וְאֵ֥לֶּה עַל־ הַבְּרֵכָ֖ה מִזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh wə·‘aḇ·ḏê ḏā·wiḏ yā·ṣə·’ū way·yip̄·gə·šūm ‘al- bə·rê·ḵaṯ giḇ·‘ō·wn yaḥ·dāw way·yê·šə·ḇū ’êl·leh ‘al- hab·bə·rê·ḵāh miz·zeh wə·’êl·leh ‘al- hab·bə·rê·ḵāh miz·zeh
verses.literal: So Joab son of Zeruiah and the servants of David marched out and met them by the pool of Gibeon . . . And the two groups took up positions on opposite sides . . . . . . . . . . . . of the pool
verses.literalPt: Saíram também Joabe, filho de Zeruia, e os servos de Davi, e se encontraram uns com os outros perto do tanque de Gibeom; e pararam estes deste lado do tanque, e os outros do outro lado do tanque.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אַבְנֵר֙ אֶל־ יוֹאָ֔ב יָק֤וּמוּ נָא֙ הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וִֽישַׂחֲק֖וּ לְפָנֵ֑ינוּ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יוֹאָ֖ב יָקֻֽמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’aḇ·nêr ’el- yō·w·’āḇ yā·qū·mū nā han·nə·‘ā·rîm wî·śa·ḥă·qū lə·p̄ā·nê·nū way·yō·mer yō·w·’āḇ yā·qu·mū
verses.literal: Then Abner said to Joab Let us have the young men get up . . . and compete before us Let them get up Joab replied
verses.literalPt: E disse Abner a Joabe: Deixa levantar os moços, e joguem diante de nós. E disse Joabe: Levantem-se.

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֖מוּ וַיַּעַבְר֣וּ בְמִסְפָּ֑ר שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר לְבִנְיָמִ֗ן וּלְאִ֥ישׁ בֹּ֙שֶׁת֙ בֶּן־ שָׁא֔וּל וּשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר מֵעַבְדֵ֥י דָוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qu·mū way·ya·‘aḇ·rū ḇə·mis·pār šə·nêm ‘ā·śār lə·ḇin·yā·min ū·lə·’îš bō·šeṯ ben- šā·’ūl ū·šə·nêm ‘ā·śār mê·‘aḇ·ḏê ḏā·wiḏ
verses.literal: So they got up . . . and were counted off twelve . . . for Benjamin and Ish-bosheth son of Saul and twelve . . . for David
verses.literalPt: Então se levantaram, e passaram, em número de doze de Benjamim, da parte de Is-Bosete, filho de Saul, e doze dos servos de Davi.

verses.original: וַֽיַּחֲזִ֜קוּ אִ֣ישׁ׀ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ רֵעֵ֗הוּ וְחַרְבּוֹ֙ בְּצַ֣ד רֵעֵ֔הוּ וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו וַיִּקְרָא֙ לַמָּק֣וֹם הַה֔וּא חֶלְקַ֥ת הַצֻּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·ḥă·zi·qū ’îš bə·rōš rê·‘ê·hū wə·ḥar·bōw bə·ṣaḏ rê·‘ê·hū way·yip·pə·lū yaḥ·dāw way·yiq·rā lam·mā·qō·wm ha·hū ḥel·qaṯ haṣ·ṣu·rîm ’ă·šer bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: Then each man grabbed his opponent by the head and thrust his sword into his opponent’s side and they all fell together So this place which is in Gibeon is called Helkath-hazzurim
verses.literalPt: E cada um lançou mão da cabeça do outro, cravou-lhe a espada no lado, e caíram juntos, por isso se chamou àquele lugar Helcate-Hazurim, que está junto a Gibeom.

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֧י הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה קָשָׁ֥ה עַד־ מְאֹ֖ד בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיִּנָּ֤גֶף אַבְנֵר֙ וְאַנְשֵׁ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִפְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י דָוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·hî ham·mil·ḥā·māh qā·šāh ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ bay·yō·wm ha·hū way·yin·nā·ḡep̄ ’aḇ·nêr wə·’an·šê yiś·rā·’êl lip̄·nê ‘aḇ·ḏê ḏā·wiḏ
verses.literal: The battle that day was intense and Abner and the men of Israel were defeated by the servants of David
verses.literalPt: E seguiu-se naquele dia uma crua peleja; porém Abner e os homens de Israel foram feridos diante dos servos de Davi.

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ־ שָׁ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ בְּנֵ֣י צְרוּיָ֔ה יוֹאָ֥ב וַאֲבִישַׁ֖י וַעֲשָׂהאֵ֑ל וַעֲשָׂהאֵל֙ קַ֣ל בְּרַגְלָ֔יו כְּאַחַ֥ד הַצְּבָיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū- šām šə·lō·šāh bə·nê ṣə·rū·yāh yō·w·’āḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·šay wa·‘ă·śā·h·’êl wa·‘ă·śā·h·’êl qal bə·raḡ·lāw kə·’a·ḥaḏ haṣ·ṣə·ḇā·yim ’ă·šer baś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: The three sons of Zeruiah were there Joab Abishai and Asahel Now Asahel was fleet of foot like a wild gazelle
verses.literalPt: E estavam ali os três filhos de Zeruia, Joabe, Abisai, e Asael; e Asael era ligeiro de pés, como as gazelas do campo.

verses.original: וַיִּרְדֹּ֥ף עֲשָׂהאֵ֖ל אַחֲרֵ֣י אַבְנֵ֑ר וְלֹֽא־ נָטָ֣ה לָלֶ֗כֶת עַל־ הַיָּמִין֙ וְעַֽל־ הַשְּׂמֹ֔אול מֵאַחֲרֵ֖י אַבְנֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·dōp̄ ‘ă·śā·h·’êl ’a·ḥă·rê ’aḇ·nêr wə·lō- nā·ṭāh lā·le·ḵeṯ ‘al- hay·yā·mîn wə·‘al- haś·śə·mō·wl mê·’a·ḥă·rê ’aḇ·nêr
verses.literal: and he . . . chased Abner not turning . . . . . . to the right . . . or to the left . . . in his pursuit
verses.literalPt: E Asael perseguiu a Abner; e não se desviou de detrás de Abner, nem para a direita nem para a esquerda.

verses.original: וַיִּ֤פֶן אַבְנֵר֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔יו וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הַאַתָּ֥ה זֶ֖ה עֲשָׂהאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָנֹֽכִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·p̄en ’aḇ·nêr ’a·ḥă·rāw way·yō·mer ha·’at·tāh zeh ‘ă·śā·h·’êl way·yō·mer ’ā·nō·ḵî
verses.literal: And Abner glanced back and said Is that you Asahel It is Asahel replied
verses.literalPt: E Abner, olhando para trás, perguntou: És tu Asael? E ele falou: Eu sou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣וֹ אַבְנֵ֗ר נְטֵ֤ה לְךָ֙ עַל־ יְמִֽינְךָ֙ א֣וֹ עַל־ שְׂמֹאלֶ֔ךָ וֶאֱחֹ֣ז לְךָ֗ אֶחָד֙ מֵֽהַנְּעָרִ֔ים וְקַח־ לְךָ֖ אֶת־ חֲלִצָת֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־ אָבָ֣ה עֲשָׂהאֵ֔ל לָס֖וּר מֵאַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw ’aḇ·nêr nə·ṭêh lə·ḵā ‘al- yə·mî·nə·ḵā ’ōw ‘al- śə·mō·le·ḵā we·’ĕ·ḥōz lə·ḵā ’e·ḥāḏ mê·han·nə·‘ā·rîm wə·qaḥ- lə·ḵā ’eṯ- ḥă·li·ṣā·ṯōw wə·lō- ’ā·ḇāh ‘ă·śā·h·’êl lā·sūr mê·’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: So Abner told him Turn to your right or to your left seize one of the young men and take his equipment for yourself But Asahel would not stop chasing him
verses.literalPt: Então lhe disse Abner: Desvia-te para a direita, ou para a esquerda, e lança mão de um dos moços, e toma os seus despojos. Porém Asael não quis desviar-se de detrás dele.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧סֶף ע֣וֹד אַבְנֵ֗ר לֵאמֹר֙ אֶל־ עֲשָׂהאֵ֔ל ס֥וּר לְךָ֖ מֵאַֽחֲרָ֑י לָ֤מָּה אַכֶּ֙כָּה֙ אַ֔רְצָה וְאֵיךְ֙ אֶשָּׂ֣א פָנַ֔י אֶל־ יוֹאָ֖ב אָחִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ ‘ō·wḏ ’aḇ·nêr lê·mōr ’el- ‘ă·śā·h·’êl sūr lə·ḵā mê·’a·ḥă·rāy lām·māh ’ak·kek·kāh ’ar·ṣāh wə·’êḵ ’eś·śā p̄ā·nay ’el- yō·w·’āḇ ’ā·ḥî·ḵā
verses.literal: Once again . . . Abner warned . . . Asahel Stop chasing me Why should I strike you to the ground How could I show my face to your brother Joab
verses.literalPt: Então Abner tornou a dizer a Asael: Desvia-te de detrás de mim; por que hei de eu ferir-te e dar contigo em terra? E como levantaria eu o meu rosto diante de Joabe, teu irmão?

verses.original: וַיְמָאֵ֣ן לָס֗וּר וַיַּכֵּ֣הוּ אַבְנֵר֩ בְּאַחֲרֵ֨י הַחֲנִ֜ית אֶל־ הַחֹ֗מֶשׁ וַתֵּצֵ֤א הַֽחֲנִית֙ מֵאַחֲרָ֔יו וַיִּפָּל־ שָׁ֖ם וַיָּ֣מָת תַּחַתוֹ וַיְהִ֡י כָּל־ הַבָּ֣א אֶֽל־ הַמָּקוֹם֩ אֲשֶׁר־ נָ֨פַל שָׁ֧ם עֲשָׂהאֵ֛ל וַיָּמֹ֖ת וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·mā·’ên lā·sūr way·yak·kê·hū ’aḇ·nêr bə·’a·ḥă·rê ha·ḥă·nîṯ ’el- ha·ḥō·meš wat·tê·ṣê ha·ḥă·nîṯ mê·’a·ḥă·rāw way·yip·pāl- šām way·yā·māṯ ta·ḥa·ṯō way·hî kāl- hab·bā ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- nā·p̄al šām ‘ă·śā·h·’êl way·yā·mōṯ way·ya·‘ă·mō·ḏū
verses.literal: But Asahel refused to turn away So Abner thrust the butt of his spear into his stomach and it came out his back and he fell dead . . . . . . on the spot And every man paused when he came to the place where Asahel had fallen . . . and died
verses.literalPt: Porém, não querendo ele se desviar, Abner o feriu com a ponta da lança pela quinta costela, e a lança lhe saiu por detrás, e caiu ali, e morreu naquele mesmo lugar; e sucedeu que, todos os que chegavam ao lugar onde Asael caiu e morreu, paravam.

verses.original: וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֛וּ יוֹאָ֥ב וַאֲבִישַׁ֖י אַחֲרֵ֣י אַבְנֵ֑ר וְהַשֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ בָּ֔אָה וְהֵ֗מָּה בָּ֚אוּ עַד־ גִּבְעַ֣ת אַמָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ פְּנֵי־ גִ֔יחַ דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר גִּבְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·də·p̄ū yō·w·’āḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·šay ’a·ḥă·rê ’aḇ·nêr wə·haš·še·meš bā·’āh wə·hêm·māh bā·’ū ‘aḏ- giḇ·‘aṯ ’am·māh ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê- ḡî·aḥ de·reḵ miḏ·bar giḇ·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: But Joab and Abishai . . . pursued Abner By sunset . . . they had gone as far as the hill of Ammah opposite . . . Giah on the way to the wilderness of Gibeon
verses.literalPt: Porém Joabe e Abisai perseguiram a Abner; e pôs-se o sol, chegando eles ao outeiro de Amá, que está diante de Gia, junto ao caminho do deserto de Gibeão.

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְקַבְּצ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ בִנְיָמִן֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י אַבְנֵ֔ר וַיִּהְי֖וּ לַאֲגֻדָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וַיַּ֣עַמְד֔וּ עַ֥ל רֹאשׁ־ גִּבְעָ֖ה אֶחָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·qab·bə·ṣū ḇə·nê- ḇin·yā·min ’a·ḥă·rê ’aḇ·nêr way·yih·yū la·’ă·ḡud·dāh ’e·ḥāṯ way·ya·‘am·ḏū ‘al rōš- giḇ·‘āh ’e·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: The Benjamites . . . . . . rallied to Abner formed a single unit and took their stand atop a hill
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Benjamim se ajuntaram atrás de Abner, e fizeram um batalhão, e puseram-se no cume de um outeiro.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אַבְנֵ֜ר אֶל־ יוֹאָ֗ב וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הֲלָנֶ֙צַח֙ תֹּ֣אכַל חֶ֔רֶב הֲל֣וֹא יָדַ֔עְתָּה כִּֽי־ מָרָ֥ה תִהְיֶ֖ה בָּאַחֲרוֹנָ֑ה וְעַד־ מָתַי֙ לֹֽא־ תֹאמַ֣ר לָעָ֔ם לָשׁ֖וּב מֵאַחֲרֵ֥י אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’aḇ·nêr ’el- yō·w·’āḇ way·yō·mer hă·lā·ne·ṣaḥ tō·ḵal ḥe·reḇ hă·lō·w yā·ḏa‘·tāh kî- mā·rāh ṯih·yeh bā·’a·ḥă·rō·w·nāh wə·‘aḏ- mā·ṯay lō- ṯō·mar lā·‘ām lā·šūḇ mê·’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·ḥê·hem
verses.literal: Then Abner called out to Joab Must the sword devour forever . . . Do you not realize that this will only end in bitterness . . . How long . . . . . . before you tell the troops to stop pursuing their brothers
verses.literalPt: Então Abner gritou a Joabe, e disse: Consumirá a espada para sempre? Não sabes tu que por fim haverá amargura? E até quando não hás de dizer ao povo que deixe de perseguir a seus irmãos?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יוֹאָ֔ב חַ֚י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֥י לוּלֵ֖א דִּבַּ֑רְתָּ כִּ֣י אָ֤ז מֵֽהַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ נַעֲלָ֣ה הָעָ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ מֵאַחֲרֵ֥י אָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·’āḇ ḥay hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm kî lū·lê dib·bar·tā kî ’āz mê·hab·bō·qer na·‘ă·lāh hā·‘ām ’îš mê·’a·ḥă·rê ’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: As surely as God lives Joab replied if you had not . . . spoken up . . . . . . the troops . . . would have continued pursuing their brothers until morning
verses.literalPt: E disse Joabe: Vive Deus, que, se não tivesses falado, só pela manhã o povo teria cessado, cada um, de perseguir a seu irmão.

verses.original: וַיִּתְקַ֤ע יוֹאָב֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ יִרְדְּפ֥וּ ע֖וֹד אַחֲרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹֽא־ יָסְפ֥וּ ע֖וֹד לְהִלָּחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·qa‘ yō·w·’āḇ baš·šō·w·p̄ār way·ya·‘am·ḏū kāl- hā·‘ām wə·lō- yir·də·p̄ū ‘ō·wḏ ’a·ḥă·rê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō- yā·sə·p̄ū ‘ō·wḏ lə·hil·lā·ḥêm
verses.literal: So Joab blew the ram’s horn and all the troops stopped they no longer . . . pursued Israel . . . or continued . . . to fight
verses.literalPt: Então Joabe tocou a buzina, e todo o povo parou, e não perseguiram mais a Israel; e tampouco pelejaram mais.

verses.original: וְאַבְנֵ֣ר וַֽאֲנָשָׁ֗יו הָֽלְכוּ֙ בָּֽעֲרָבָ֔ה כֹּ֖ל הַלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֑וּא וַיַּעַבְר֣וּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ כָּל־ הַבִּתְר֔וֹן וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ מַחֲנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·nêr wa·’ă·nā·šāw hā·lə·ḵū bā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh kōl hal·lay·lāh ha·hū way·ya·‘aḇ·rū ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên way·yê·lə·ḵū kāl- hab·biṯ·rō·wn way·yā·ḇō·’ū ma·ḥă·nā·yim
verses.literal: And all that night Abner and his men marched through the Arabah They crossed the Jordan marched all morning and arrived at Mahanaim
verses.literalPt: E caminharam Abner e os seus homens toda aquela noite pela planície; e, passando o Jordão, caminharam por todo o Bitrom, e chegaram a Maanaim.

verses.original: וְיוֹאָ֗ב שָׁ֚ב מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י אַבְנֵ֔ר וַיִּקְבֹּ֖ץ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֑ם וַיִּפָּ֨קְד֜וּ מֵעַבְדֵ֥י דָוִ֛ד תִּשְׁעָֽה־ עָשָׂ֥ר אִ֖ישׁ וַעֲשָׂה־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·’āḇ šāb̲ mê·’a·ḥă·rê ’aḇ·nêr way·yiq·bōṣ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ām way·yip·pā·qə·ḏū mê·‘aḇ·ḏê ḏā·wiḏ tiš·‘āh- ‘ā·śār ’îš wa·‘ă·śāh- ’êl
verses.literal: When Joab returned from pursuing Abner he gathered all the troops In addition to Asahel . . . nineteen . . . . . . of David’s servants were missing
verses.literalPt: Também Joabe voltou de perseguir a Abner, e ajuntou todo o povo; e dos servos de Davi faltaram dezenove homens, e Asael.

verses.original: וְעַבְדֵ֣י דָוִ֗ד הִכּוּ֙ מִבִּנְיָמִ֔ן וּבְאַנְשֵׁ֖י אַבְנֵ֑ר שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֧וֹת וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אִ֖ישׁ מֵֽתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘aḇ·ḏê ḏā·wiḏ hik·kū mib·bin·yā·min ū·ḇə·’an·šê ’aḇ·nêr šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ wə·šiš·šîm ’îš mê·ṯū
verses.literal: but they . . . had struck down 360 . . . . . . . . . . . . Benjamites who were with Abner
verses.literalPt: Porém os servos de Davi feriram dentre os de Benjamim, e dentre os homens de Abner, a trezentos e sessenta homens, que ali ficaram mortos.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־ עֲשָׂהאֵ֔ל וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֙הוּ֙ בְּקֶ֣בֶר אָבִ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית לָ֑חֶם וַיֵּלְכ֣וּ כָל־ הַלַּ֗יְלָה יוֹאָב֙ וַֽאֲנָשָׁ֔יו וַיֵּאֹ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם בְּחֶבְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·’ū ’eṯ- ‘ă·śā·h·’êl way·yiq·bə·ru·hū bə·qe·ḇer ’ā·ḇîw ’ă·šer bêṯ lā·ḥem way·yê·lə·ḵū ḵāl hal·lay·lāh yō·w·’āḇ wa·’ă·nā·šāw way·yê·’ōr lā·hem bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn
verses.literal: And they took Asahel and buried him in his father’s tomb in Bethlehem Then Joab and his men marched all night and reached Hebron at daybreak
verses.literalPt: E levantaram a Asael, e sepultaram-no na sepultura de seu pai, que estava em Belém; e Joabe e seus homens caminharam toda aquela noite, e amanheceu-lhes o dia em Hebrom.
